design_motivation: 现有ViT模型多基于单分辨率WSI预训练，难以泛化到任意分辨率。病理诊断本质上是多尺度的（从细胞形态到组织结构）。MRPT设计为多分辨率金字塔Transformer，通过Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) 机制模拟病理学家由低倍到高倍逐级观察的推理过程，实现跨分辨率的语义对齐和层级特征聚合，从而构建更鲁棒、可解释的WSI表示。
loss_formula: Stage 1 (Patch): \mathcal{L}_{SSL} = -\sum_{i} \log \frac{\exp(\text{sim}(z_i, t_i)/\tau)}{\sum_{j} \exp(\text{sim}(z_i, t_j)/\tau)} \quad \text{(SimCLR-style contrastive loss)}\nStage 2 (Region): \mathcal{L}_{align} = \sum_{s} \| \mathbf{E}_{s} - \mathbf{E}_{s+1} \|_2^2 \quad \text{(Cross-resolution alignment loss)}\nStage 3 (WSI): \mathcal{L}_{cls} = \text{CrossEntropy}(\mathbf{y}, \text{MLP}([mCLS]))
math_principle: 利用对比学习（Contrastive Learning）在Patch级学习多分辨率特征；通过最小化相邻分辨率嵌入间的欧氏距离（或余弦相似度最大化）实现跨分辨率语义一致性；采用层级聚合（Hierarchical Aggregation）将细胞级Token逐步融合为WSI级表示，CCRA机制通过交叉注意力在相邻分辨率间传递信息，确保特征流形上的连续性。

tensor_flow.shape: [B, N, D] (N: number of patches, D: embedding dim)

training_pipeline: Step 1: Data Preparation - Extract patches/regions/WSIs at 10x, 20x, 40x resolutions from 36K WSIs (624M patches, 2.4M regions).
Step 2: Stage 1 Pre-training - Train multi-resolution patch-level ViT (mViT) using self-supervised contrastive loss on patches.
Step 3: Stage 2 Pre-training - Train region-level aggregation with CCRA mechanism to align region embeddings across consecutive resolutions.
Step 4: Stage 3 Pre-training - Train WSI-level representation using class token fusion and cross-resolution attention on full WSIs.
Step 5: Fine-tuning - Linear probing or full fine-tuning on downstream tasks (classification, VQA, captioning).
Step 6: MRPT-LLaVA Training - Align MRPT encoder with LLM via three-stage pipeline (caption alignment, word-visual alignment, VQA fine-tuning).

key_results.PANDA_BA: 5.2 min per WSI (linear probe), surpasses SOTA in Balanced Accuracy
key_results.Zero_Shot: Superior patch-level zero-shot classification compared to single-resolution models
